name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College and University Students
provider: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Govt. of India
description: Financial assistance to meritorious students from low-income families to meet day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher studies in college and university.
benefit: ₹12,000 per annum at Graduation level for first 3 years and ₹20,000 per annum at Post Graduation level
requiredDocuments: Class 12th Board Marksheet showing 80th percentile or above
Valid Income Certificate issued by competent revenue authority (Tahsildar/MRO)
Proof of admission in regular college/university course
Bank Account Passbook seeded with Aadhaar
Valid Student ID Card
applicationProcess: 1. Register on National Scholarship Portal (NSP). 2. Complete OTR (One Time Registration). 3. Fill academic and income details. 4. Upload verified documents. 5. College verification followed by State Nodal Officer approval.

name: Telangana ePASS Post-Matric Scholarship (RTF & MTF)
description: Comprehensive fee reimbursement (RTF) and maintenance charges (MTF) for eligible SC, ST, BC, EBC, and Minority students pursuing post-matriculation courses in Telangana.
benefit: Full Tuition Fee Reimbursement (RTF) directly to college + Monthly Maintenance Allowance (MTF) up to ₹20,000/year
requiredDocuments: Telangana Nativity / Domicile Certificate
Integrated Caste & Sub-caste Certificate issued by MeeSeva
Valid Income Certificate issued on or after 01-04-2026
Previous Class / Semester Marksheet
College Allotment Order and Fee Receipt
Aadhaar card copy
applicationProcess: 1. Apply online via Telangana ePASS portal. 2. Select Fresh or Renewal application. 3. Enter CET hall ticket number, admission details, and bank account. 4. Submit hard copies along with original certificates to college principal for verification.

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students
provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
description: Empowering young women by providing financial assistance to advance technical education in AICTE-approved institutions across India.
benefit: ₹50,000 per annum for every year of study towards college fee payment, computer, stationery, books, and equipment
requiredDocuments: Admission letter for Degree/Diploma issued by Central/State counseling authority
Family Income Certificate showing annual income below ₹8 Lakhs
Marksheet of Qualifying Examination (10th / 10+2)
Tuition fee receipt
Declaration by parents regarding girl child quota (maximum 2 girl children per family)
applicationProcess: 1. Register on National Scholarship Portal under AICTE Schemes. 2. Choose Pragati Scheme (Degree or Diploma). 3. Submit academic credentials and father/mother income details. 4. Verification by Institute Nodal Officer.

name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Specially Abled Students
provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
description: Dedicated financial support to encourage differently-abled students with disability not less than 40% to pursue professional technical education.
benefit: ₹50,000 per annum for each year of technical study towards tuition, assistive aids, computer, and books
requiredDocuments: Disability Certificate issued by competent Medical Board (minimum 40% disability)
Admission proof in AICTE approved institution
Family Income Certificate below ₹8 Lakhs per annum
Previous qualification marksheet
Bank Account details seeded with Aadhaar
applicationProcess: 1. Register on National Scholarship Portal (NSP). 2. Submit disability certificate and institutional admission details. 3. Verification by head of institution and AICTE cell.

name: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarship
description: Supports meritorious undergraduate students from economically disadvantaged backgrounds with grants, leadership training, and strong alumni mentoring.
benefit: Up to ₹2,00,000 total grant over the entire duration of undergraduate study plus mentorship programs
requiredDocuments: Class 12th Board Marksheet
Bonafide Student Certificate from currently enrolled college
Family Income Certificate / ITR / Ration card
Two passport-sized photographs
Identity and Address proof
applicationProcess: 1. Online application on Reliance Foundation scholarships portal. 2. Aptitude test covering verbal, analytical, and numerical reasoning. 3. Review of academic performance and household income. 4. Announcement of selected scholars.

name: HDFC Bank Parivartan's Educational Crisis Scholarship Support (ECSS)
description: Assists students facing personal, medical, or economic crises to prevent dropouts and ensure uninterrupted education from school to university level.
benefit: Scholarship grant ranging from ₹35,000 to ₹75,000 depending on course level
requiredDocuments: Previous year marksheet showing at least 55% marks
Proof of admission (college ID card, fee receipt, or admission letter)
Proof of family crisis (loss of earning member, critical medical treatment, or job loss)
Salary slips / Income certificate / Ration Card
Bank passbook copy
applicationProcess: 1. Apply via CSR partner portal (Buddy4Study). 2. Submit proof of current enrolment and crisis documentation. 3. Telephonic interview and document verification by social impact panel.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Students Belonging to Minority Communities
provider: Ministry of Minority Affairs, Govt. of India
description: Encouraging higher education among students from notified minority communities (Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Jains, and Parsis).
benefit: Admission and course fee up to ₹10,000/annum plus maintenance allowance up to ₹1,200/month
requiredDocuments: Self-declaration of minority community by student
Annual income certificate below ₹2 Lakhs issued by Revenue Authority
Marksheet of previous year with not less than 50% aggregate
Fee receipt of current academic course
Bank account details
applicationProcess: 1. Apply online through National Scholarship Portal (NSP). 2. Choose Ministry of Minority Affairs section. 3. Upload community self-attestation and academic details.

name: Sitaram Jindal Foundation Scholarship Scheme
description: Charitable educational grants for poor and deserving students across India pursuing general graduation, technical courses, and medical degrees.
benefit: Monthly stipend of ₹1,400 to ₹3,200 depending on degree and hostel/day-scholar status
requiredDocuments: Marksheet of previous examination (minimum 65% for boys, 60% for girls)
Income certificate issued by competent authority
Certificate regarding annual fees from College Principal
Hostel warden certificate if staying in hostel
Recommendation letter from college head
applicationProcess: 1. Download official application form from SJF website. 2. Fill in details and get it signed by college principal. 3. Post the hard copy with attested documents to Jindal Nagar Bangalore office.

name: Dr. Ambedkar Post-Matric Scholarship for EBC Students
provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Govt. of India
description: Financial assistance to students belonging to Economically Backward Classes (General Category low-income families) for post-matriculation studies.
benefit: Maintenance allowance up to ₹750/month along with reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable fees
requiredDocuments: Income certificate verifying income below ₹2.5 Lakhs
EWS / Economically Backward Class Certificate
Previous examination marksheet
College enrollment proof
Bank passbook copy
applicationProcess: 1. Submit application on State Scholarship Portal or NSP. 2. Verify through District Social Welfare Officer. 3. Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to student account.

name: Adilabad District Merit-cum-Means Academic Assistance Scheme
description: Sample academic scheme created for college demonstration to illustrate regional eligibility matching for students residing in Adilabad and adjacent districts of Telangana.
benefit: Sample demonstration grant of ₹25,000 per academic year for books, stationery, and hostel fee subsidy
requiredDocuments: Study certificate issued by institution located in Adilabad / Telangana
Previous qualifying examination marksheet (minimum 70%)
MRO certified income certificate
Domicile / Residence Certificate
applicationProcess: Demonstration simulated process: 1. Fill student profile on portal. 2. Verification of Adilabad district residence and score. 3. Mock approval simulation.

name: Telangana State STEM Excellence Fellowship for Women
description: Sample demonstration scheme intended to reward female students excelling in Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics courses in Telangana universities.
benefit: Sample demonstration grant of ₹40,000 per year towards research project work and technology equipment
requiredDocuments: Marksheet showing minimum 75% aggregate in STEM subjects
Proof of admission in accredited Telangana institution
Income declaration certificate
Statement of purpose / project brief
applicationProcess: Demonstration simulation: Application submission via college portal with faculty advisor endorsement.

name: PM-YASASVI Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
provider: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Govt. of India
description: Central government scholarship scheme for OBC, Economically Backward Classes (EBC), and De-notified Nomadic Tribes (DNT) studying at post-matriculation stage.
benefit: Full academic fees plus annual maintenance allowance up to ₹13,500 for hostellers and ₹7,000 for day-scholars
requiredDocuments: Valid Community Certificate (OBC / EBC / DNT)
Income Certificate from authorized government official (< ₹2.5 Lakh)
Academic marksheet of previous class
Fee payment receipt and Bonafide Certificate
Aadhaar linked bank account
applicationProcess: 1. Register on National Scholarship Portal (NSP). 2. Submit application under PM-YASASVI scheme. 3. Bio-metric authentication and institute level e-verification.
